recipe.visualDefinition: A central group portrait framed within a weathered, recessed window of a crumbling stucco wall. The composition uses a muted, warm-toned palette with a focus on organic textures and vintage typography placed above the architectural framing.
coreVisualRelationships: The window frame acts as a secondary border for the human subjects.
The rough texture of the stucco wall contrasts with the smooth, condensed letterforms.
The warm orange-red of the top text complements the earthy tones of the wall and clothing.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subjects are clustered inside a central window frame, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, bold condensed serif title centered above the window lintel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top technical metadata, moves down to the red names, hits the bold title, and settles into the group portrait inside the window.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the expansive, textured wall surrounding the central window.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Orange-Red (secondary text and clothing accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the wall area; deep shadows inside the window create a sense of depth.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses ultra-condensed, high-contrast serifs with vertical stress.
Secondary text uses a bold, slanted slab serif (oblique).
Technical headers use geometric, wide, stencil-like or dot-matrix influenced forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked vertical orientation for small articles (e.g., 'THE')

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the flat wall surface

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast condensed serif for impact paired with a friendly, slanted slab for names.
graphicDevices: Dot-dash horizontal lines for technical headers
Illustrative logo in the top right corner

preserve: Condensed verticality of the main title
Slanted nature of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed high-contrast serif style of the main title.
Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and slant of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a group of four people in 1960s folk attire (turtlenecks, ponchos, yellow dresses) looking out from a recessed, square window set in a heavily weathered, cracked, beige stucco wall. The lighting is soft and warm, reminiscent of 35mm film photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-condensed serif title in dark charcoal centered above the window. Above that, add a line of names in bold, slanted orange-red slab serif separated by dots. Include a technical header at the very top with dots and dashes.

verificationChecks: Is the wall texture sufficiently cracked and aged?
Is the main title font vertically elongated?
Are the colors muted and warm-toned?
Is the group portrait contained strictly within the window frame?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the window
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the window frame.
Check that the stucco texture looks organic, not tiled.
Verify the 'THE' is stacked vertically to the left of the main words.
Confirm the color of the names is a distinct orange-red.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a textured architectural element (door/window) + place subjects inside + use high-contrast condensed serif typography on the surrounding negative space.
